main_body: Round wooden podium platform: a wide tan oval top with a short brown front face, and a music stand with a small sign on top
top_band: Light tan oval top, rows ~13-25 in the middle column, ending in a lighter yellow-ochre edge at rows ~25-26
evidence: The middle column starts at the dark outline (row ~11), then a large tan elliptical top (rows ~13-25), then a light yellow-ochre front-edge line (rows ~25-26), then a darker brown front face (rows ~27-31). The top is a clear horizontal surface much larger than the front face, and the front face is a distinct vertical band. The front face is plain and has no eave shadow or recesses, but the top band and front face are both clearly drawn, so it reads as 3/4.

style.evidence: The outline is dark brown, tinted to match the wood, which is good. But the top is a huge area of one tan colour, about 14x10 px, with only a few edge highlights and no grain, plank lines or dots. The front face is a smooth 2-3 step gradient. The sign and pole are simple. Next to the stall and well references, which carry tile scallops, stone-by-stone shading and many colours per tile, most tiles here hold only 2-4 colours, so it looks flatter and thinner.
